fieldOverrides._comment: Task 4.5 — notifyGroupMembersOnDropCreated resolves recipients with collectionGroup('groups').where('code','==',...). Default single-field indexing covers COLLECTION scope only, so without the COLLECTION_GROUP entry every invocation failed FAILED_PRECONDITION. The three COLLECTION entries are repeated here because a fieldOverrides entry REPLACES the defaults rather than adding to them.

Same failure, found while verifying the 4.6 deploy: deleteAccount's deleteOwnedInventoryCopies runs collectionGroup('inventory').where('id','in',...). Without this, deleting an account that ever created a drop failed FAILED_PRECONDITION after report anonymisation had already run — a partial deletion. The COLLECTION entries are repeated for the same replacement reason as above.
